equality_policy.identity_count_enum_string_policy: Exact, type-checked equality; reject bool-as-int, coercion, trimming, case folding, omitted namespaces and missing required fields.

equality_policy.order: Use strictly increasing contiguous seq, not strict timestamp inequalities. No reordering to manufacture expected history.
